Produced by Columbia Pictures in association with Bona Film Group , Heyday Films , and Visiona Romantica, and distributed by Sony Pictures Releasing , it is a co-production between the United States , United Kingdom , and China . DiCaprio , Brad Pitt , and Margot Robbie . Set in 1969 Los Angeles , the film follows a fading actor and his adrenaline junkie stunt double as they navigate the rapidly changing film industry with the threat of the Tate murders looming. Announced in July 2017, it is Tarantino's first film not to involve Bob and Harvey Weinstein , as he ended his partnership with the brothers following the sexual abuse allegations against Harvey Weinstein . After a bidding war, the film was distributed by Sony Pictures Releasing, which met Tarantino's demands, including final cut privilege . Pitt, DiCaprio, Robbie, Zoë Bell , Kurt Russell and others joined the cast between January and June 2018. Principal photography lasted from June through November around Los Angeles. Once Upon a Time in Hollywood is the final film to feature Luke Perry , who died on March 4, 2019, and is dedicated to his memory. Once Upon a Time in Hollywood premiered at the 2019 Cannes Film Festival on May 21, 2019, and was theatrically released in the United States on July 26, and in the United Kingdom on August 14. It grossed over $393 million worldwide and received acclaim from critics, although historical inaccuracies and the portrayals of some artists were criticized. The National Board of Review and the American Film Institute named Once Upon a Time in Hollywood as one of the Top-10 films of 2019, and it won the Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy . Once Upon a Time in Hollywood was nominated for 10 awards at the 92nd Academy Awards , winning two ( Best Supporting Actor for Pitt and Best Production Design ), and received numerous other accolades . It has since been considered as one of the greatest films of the 2010s and 21st century. [ b ] The Writers Guild of America ranked the film's screenplay the 22nd-greatest of the 21st

[ 18 ] [ 19 ] [ 20 ] A novelization , written by Tarantino in his debut as an author, was published in 2021. A sequel to the film, The Adventures of Cliff Booth , written by Tarantino and directed by David Fincher , with Pitt in the lead role, is currently in production, [ 21 ] and is scheduled to be released in 2026. [ 22 ] Plot [ edit ] In February 1969, Hollywood actor Rick Dalton, a former Western TV star , copes with a fading career, his most recent roles being guest appearances as TV villains. Agent Marvin Schwarz suggests working in spaghetti Westerns in Italy, which Rick considers inferior. considers inferior. Rick's best friend, stunt double , personal assistant, and driver is Cliff Booth, a World War II special ops veteran living in a trailer with his pit bull Brandy. Cliff struggles to find stunt work due to a past altercation with Bruce Lee and rumors that he had murdered his wife. Although he does not know them personally, Rick is aware that young actress Sharon Tate and her husband, director Roman Polanski , live next door . Rick longs to befriend them, thinking it could reignite his career. While fixing the TV antenna on Rick's roof, Cliff notices a hippie arriving at the Polanski residence. The man, Charles Manson , asks for music producer Terry Melcher , but Tate's friend, Jay Sebring , says Melcher has moved. Later, Tate watches herself in The Wrecking Crew at a local film theater , and Cliff gives hitchhiker Pussycat a ride to Spahn Ranch , a former Western film set where Cliff did stunt work. Cliff checks on George Spahn , the ranch's nearly blind owner, seeking to make sure the hippies living there are not exploiting him. Cliff physically forces ranch hippie Clem to change his car tire after it was deliberately punctured. The hippies' leader Tex is summoned to deal with the situation, but he arrives as Cliff is driving away. While filming an episode for the TV series Lancer , Rick struggles to deliver his lines, causing him to have an emotional breakdown in his trailer. Before returning to the US, Rick tells Cliff that he can no longer afford his salary, which Cliff amicably understands. Returning to Los Angeles on August 8, 1969, Rick and Cliff go drinking to commemorate their time together. Returning to Rick's house, Cliff smokes an acid -laced cigarette and takes Brandy for a walk, while Rick makes margaritas . Manson's followers Tex, Sadie , Katie and Flowerchild arrive to murder the Tate house occupants . Hearing a car's loud muffler , an enraged Rick orders the group off the private street. Recognizing him, the family members decide to kill him instead, when Sadie reasons that through television shows such as Rick's, Hollywood has "taught them to murder". Flowerchild deserts the group, fleeing with their car. His film career never took off, and in 1967 he started to guest star on TV series as villains.
